　Just what do you know!?」

stage0091_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Everything in the universe.
　I have even touched the 《$$黒の英知$$》
　that lay within the black hole.」

stage0091_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$葵$$
「I knew it, he had it too!」

stage0091_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's said to grant power and knowledge
　to whoever obtains it.」

stage0091_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It exists in every parallel world, beyond the walls of dimension.」

stage0091_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$カレン$$
「The annoying part is,
　whoever gets their hands on it is usually a villain!」

stage0091_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「So it seems you call the powerful 'evil.'」

stage0091_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$赤木$$
「Someone who runs wild with power
　could never be a hero of justice!」

stage0091_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then I'll silence you all,
　with my overwhelming power!」

stage0091_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're... the robot that was with $$グーラ$$!」

stage0091_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ロビー$$
「My name is $$ロビー$$.
　For a hundred years since my homeworld was destroyed...
　I have waited for this chance at revenge.」

stage0091_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ロビー$$
「This isn't betrayal!
　I never once swore loyalty to the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0091_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You spineless robot.
　Riding on the Earthlings' coattails to defy me?」

stage0091_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Fight, Earthlings!
　The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ sees you as enemies
　because he fears you!」

stage0091_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Only you can destroy the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0091_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We have that kind of power...」

stage0091_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ロビー$$
「The last key to defeating the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　is the positive power that cancels out his negative...」

stage0091_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's as far as you go, $$ロビー$$!」

stage0091_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ロビー$$
「I-I'm counting on you, Earthlings...!
　Avenge my homeworld!!」

stage0091_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$甲児$$
「He... he staked his life
　to tell us the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s weakness!」

stage0091_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We can't let his sacrifice be in vain!」

stage0091_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Foolish...!
　Even after my causality reversal, your spirits are still unbroken!?」

stage0091_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$シン$$
「We never thought we'd win without a scratch!
　We're prepared to take some damage!」

stage0091_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$刹那$$
「We take him down before we run out of strength...!
　That's all there is to it!」

stage0091_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Whether we fall first, or he does...
　That's the fight」

stage0091_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Accept the truth of the universe, Earthlings...!
　And give me those spirit particles of yours...」

stage0091_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Like we'd listen to another word from you!」

stage0091_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We will never give up!
　We will defeat you and protect the Earth, I swear it!」

stage0091_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We're running out of time...!
　All units, press on without fear of sacrifice!」

stage0091_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Here we come, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　I'll show you the strength of a cornered human!」

stage0091_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　We're taking down the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!!」

stage0091_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Damn you!
　Earthlings, how dare you!!」

stage0091_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I am the embodiment of a black hole!
　My power is infinite!!」

stage0091_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is there no way to completely destroy him!?」

stage0091_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Could it be... what $$ロビー$$ said at the end...?」

stage0091_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The positive force that cancels out
　the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s negative force...」

stage0091_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If the black hole is negative $$次元力$$,
　then the positive force is...」

stage0091_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The sun...!
　His black hole was sealed away by
　the $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$'s solar power!」

stage0091_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$アルト$$
「But there's no $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ here...!」

stage0091_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$タケル$$
「$c, too... has the power of the sun...」

stage0091_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$'s solar energy converter...!
　If we open it all the way at once...!」

stage0091_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait, $$正太郎$$!
　If you do that...!」

stage0091_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't stop me, $$ワッ太$$...
　I've finally made up my mind...」

stage0091_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We've fought to protect the Earth...
　For the sake of peace... we can't
　hold back on any sacrifice...!」

stage0091_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This power... it's the sun's!」

stage0091_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$田中司令$$
「It seems Altair too has vanished
　beyond the dimension」

stage0091_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$タケル$$
「Lift your head, and go welcome $$鉄人$$!」

stage0091_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$タケル$$
「No, $$ロゼ$$.
　My brother lent me his strength」

stage0091_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$タケル$$
（Thank you, brother...
　You're still watching over me, aren't you）

stage0091_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Now we can chase after $$カグラ$$」

stage0091_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「What do you mean, too late!?」

stage0091_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ニア$$
「The system set on that star will activate」

stage0091_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ニア$$
「Bearers of the $$烙印$$.
　You will return to nothingness, once」

stage0091_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We did it!
　We beat the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0091_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ is recovering
　from the damage!」

stage0091_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$柿小路$$
「No way...!
　What was all our hard work for!?」

stage0091_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「The likes of you wouldn't understand.
　This too is one of my powers」

stage0091_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「But that black hole, which should be
　the source of his power, is gone!」

stage0091_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「It hasn't vanished.
　It's merely sealed away by the sun's power」

stage0091_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「And so long as the sun's shadow...
　the power of darkness endures,
　it remains my power」

stage0091_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Fufu... the embodiment of cosmic darkness...
　So you used my power, did you）

stage0091_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$!」

stage0091_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So basically, unless we take him down,
　the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ will just keep coming back!」

stage0091_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ can wait!
　Target the $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$ first!」

stage0091_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... interesting!
　You're coming on your own to be prey
　for me and the Wings of the sun!?」

stage0091_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　Don't think you can keep doing
　whatever you want forever!」

stage0091_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Seven minutes have passed since the operation began」

stage0091_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, hurry!
　We'll settle this in the next minute!」

stage0091_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Eight minutes have passed since the operation began!」

stage0091_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「As Altair and Earth draw closer,
　a great cataclysm will strike both worlds...!」

stage0091_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you understand, $$カグラ$$!
　Our father and mother never wanted
　anything like this!」

stage0091_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$イズモ$$, Altair's Supreme Commander!」

stage0091_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$イズモ$$, that old geezer... is my father...」

stage0091_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Father entrusted us with the future of both worlds!
　And yet you...!」

stage0091_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What's that got to do with anything!」

stage0091_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$カグラ$$
「As long as I have my worst damn woman, I need nothing else!
　Anyone who gets in the way, I'll kill them, whoever they are!」

stage0091_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「The weakling's gotten all high and mighty with his anger!
　But you can't beat me!」

stage0091_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Shut up, $$カグラ$$!
　I'll stop you, I swear it!」

stage0091_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And I'll take back $$ミコノ$$,
　and protect both worlds!!」

stage0091_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, hey, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　There's something I want to tell you!」

stage0091_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「What business does an Earthling brat
　have with me, king of the universe?」

stage0091_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Because you taught $$グーラ$$ such
　twisted things, we had to fight!」

stage0091_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You might be $$グーラ$$'s old man,
　but we were $$グーラ$$'s friends!
　I'll beat you for his sake too!」

stage0091_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Can the likes of you manage that?」

stage0091_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You stubborn old Spartan hardhead!
　Go let my old man punch you
　in the afterlife!!」

stage0091_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Mars!
　Your current power alone won't be enough to beat me!」

stage0091_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$タケル$$
「This pressure...!
　It rivals Emperor $$ズール$$, or more!」

stage0091_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「His dark power is the same as mine, deep down!
　One like you, not yet awake to true power,
　is no match for me!」

stage0091_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That is something you will never know!」

stage0091_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Die, Mars!
　Be swallowed by darkness, still one-winged!」

stage0091_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　We'll take down the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　who led $$グーラ$$ into battle!」

stage0091_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Don't get carried away just because
　you beat $$グーラ$$!
　My power outstrips your imagination!」

stage0091_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Even so, we'll fight!
　For the peace of Earth!」

stage0091_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This heart, without a shred of doubt...!
　And the power of the sun!
　Together, they are dangerous!」

stage0091_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$鉄人２８号#robot$$ and $$金田正太郎$$!
　It seems you two are my arch-enemies!
　I'll settle this myself, right here!」

stage0091_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Just what I wanted, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　I'll show you the strength of $$鉄人$$'s
　power, mine, and our wish for peace!!」

stage0091_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$葵$$
「Parents who jerk their kids around
　with nonsense logic are nothing
　but harmful!」

stage0091_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Says the one who doesn't even
　know her own parents' faces.」

stage0091_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$葵$$
「So what!
　I've got friends who matter more
　than parents I've never even seen!」

stage0091_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$葵$$
「$$グーラ$$ realized that too!
　That friends who worry about you
　matter more than a selfish parent!」

stage0091_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$葵$$
「In place of that kid's unspoken scream,
　I'll say it to you myself!」

stage0091_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「A demon god who inherited
　the light god's power!
　But even that light can't overcome my darkness!」

stage0091_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$甲児$$
「You won't know 'til you try!
　Even with the power of a black hole,
　don't think that'll crush my fighting spirit!」

stage0091_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$甲児$$
「I won't let Earth, or our future,
　be swallowed up by darkness!」

stage0091_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Even Getter rays mean nothing
　inside a black hole!
　You cannot defeat me!」

stage0091_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Who gives a damn about Getter rays!
　It's my fists and my kicks
　that'll crush you!」

stage0091_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This man...!
　Isn't he the eternal warrior
　chosen by Getter rays!?」

stage0091_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's none of my damn business!
　If you call yourself a king, then
　fight with your own strength, no cheap tricks!」

stage0091_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll blast right through it
　head-on!!」

stage0091_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Apostle of the Getter rays.
　Whatever you do,
　it's already too late.」

stage0091_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「The universe is trying to be reborn!
　Earthlings simply didn't make it in time!」

stage0091_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$號$$
「That's not yours to decide!
　It's Earthlings themselves who decide!」

stage0091_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$號$$
「If you'd crush that possibility
　out of your own desire,
　then Getter and I will fight you!」

stage0091_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「A human who's awakened to no power,
　who merely lives day by day,
　dares challenge me?」

stage0091_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$赤木$$
「What's wrong with that!
　I won't let someone who mocks people
　living their hardest have his way with our Earth!」

stage0091_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Can't you understand it's futile?
　Ignorance truly is a frightening thing.」

stage0091_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you're gonna talk down to me
　like that, then try and stop me!」

stage0091_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you can't do that,
　then quit posing as some
　'demon king of the universe'!!」

stage0091_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Altair and Vega!
　I won't let your malice
　swallow both worlds!」

stage0091_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Despite inheriting part
　of the Wings' power,
　you still don't grasp this universe's situation!」

stage0091_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I know that already!
　That someone like you
　can't be left alone!」

stage0091_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「My father and mother's wish!
　I'll show I can protect Altair and Vega's future!」

stage0091_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Not even your Spiral
　can pierce my black hole!」

stage0091_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$シモン$$
「Black hole, whatever, it's still
　just a hole in the end!
　Then I'll dig through it, no matter how far!」

stage0091_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$シモン$$
「Dig, dig, keep on digging!
　Even to the far side of the universe,
　I'll find a way out! Swallowing me is pointless!」

stage0091_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This man's Spiral...!
　It's reaching upward!?」

stage0091_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's my drill!
　And this is the power
　that'll punch right through you!!」

stage0091_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　A name that sounds evil enough,
　and a look that matches!」

stage0091_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Any enemy threatening Earth's peace
　will be met by me and the $$ガンバスター$$!」

stage0091_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This one truly isn't afraid of me!?」

stage0091_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「You might not look it, but I'm
　$$タカヤ・ノリコ$$, back from a black hole!
　I won't lose to the likes of you!」

stage0091_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Here I come, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　$$ガンバスター$$'s flames will burn away your darkness!」

stage0091_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「To have your life changed by a parent's whims...!」

stage0091_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$ couldn't live up to that expectation.
　And in the end, was defeated.」

stage0091_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But $$グーラ$$ decided their own way to live, on their own!
　$$グーラ$$ isn't your tool!」

stage0091_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm... going to fight you!
　By my own will!」

stage0091_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$n
「A father is a man's first, greatest teacher...」

stage0091_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「What are you trying to say?」

stage0091_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$n
「Next time I see $$グーラ$$, I'll teach them.
　That a father's a wall to overcome someday.」

stage0091_04:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
